purpose: Provisional five-minute IT evaluation environment; not a validated facility digital twin
allocation: Fixed integer N per service from its observed one-minute peak; equal offered intensity within service
low_rate_policy: Keep offered arrivals unchanged. Below 1 rps use explicit M3 mathematical extension and R3 coefficients at 1 rps; flag and bound the steady-power extension.

carryover_comparison.bridge: M3 at steady-equivalent offered rate mu_hat(R), normalized mean work=1; hypothetical state-to-power link, not measured completion rate
carryover_comparison.residual_policy: Omit R3 in paired bridge comparison to isolate structural effects; it is retained in the long baseline
